context: A uni student encourages his teen friend to try something new
purpose: Teach: うっかり/おもい/おなか/つづく/とれる/はじめる/はたして/ましてや

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: サクラ、最近おなか出てきたんじゃない?ちょっと運動した方がいいよ。
lines.en: Sakura, your belly's getting bigger, isn't it? You should exercise a bit.
lines.style: Teasing, warm tone with gentle older-brother concern.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ひどい!でも確かに、毎日寝る前にお菓子食べる習慣がずっとつづくんだよね…。
lines.en: That's mean! But yeah, this habit of eating snacks before bed every night just keeps going on…
lines.style: Mock-offended teen voice, slightly whiny and self-aware.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: じゃあさ、何か新しいことをはじめるといいよ。ドラムとか、興味なかった?
lines.en: Then come on, you should start something new. Like drums, weren't you interested in that?
lines.style: Encouraging upbeat suggestion, leaning forward enthusiastically.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ドラムは音が大きすぎ!近所迷惑だし、はたして親が許してくれるかな…。
lines.en: Drums are way too loud! It'd bother the neighbors, and I really wonder if my parents would allow it.
lines.style: Doubtful teenage hesitation, trailing off uncertainly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: あ、うっかり言い忘れてた、防音スタジオがあるじゃん。安く借りられるとこ知ってるよ。
lines.en: Oh, I forgot to mention — there are soundproof studios. I know a cheap place you can rent.
lines.style: Bright recovery, snapping fingers as he remembers.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 本当?でもスティックっておもい感じしない?手が痛くなりそうで心配なんだけど。
lines.en: Really? But don't the sticks feel heavy? I'm worried my hands will hurt.
lines.style: Curious but timid, half-convinced teenage voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 全然軽いよ!すぐ慣れる。予約もネットで簡単にとれるし、今週末一緒に行こうよ。
lines.en: They're totally light! You get used to it fast. Bookings are easy online too — let's go this weekend.
lines.style: Confident, decisive invitation with friendly push.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん、やってみる!ドラムどころか、ましてやバンドを組むのもいいかもね。
lines.en: Okay, I'll try it! Forget drums — let alone starting a band might be cool too, huh?
lines.style: Newly motivated teen, ending with playful upbeat flair.
